# Security Review Checklist

- [ ] Threat model covers affected scope.
- [ ] Access control matrix updated.
- [ ] Auth and ownership checks enforced at server/service boundaries.
- [ ] Sensitive data classified.
- [ ] Secrets are protected.
- [ ] Logs exclude sensitive data.
- [ ] Input validation and output handling reviewed.
- [ ] Dependency risks reviewed.
- [ ] Abuse cases have tests or manual verification.
- [ ] Residual risks accepted by owner.
